roles.name: Project Manager
success_checks: Docs capture gameplay, timing, leaderboard, data panel, backend routes, storage strategy
Checklist covers QA of data integration and gameplay flow
Tasks clearly assign work to Designer, Data Scanner, Frontend, Backend, Tester

roles.name: Designer
success_checks: Spec defines layout with game area, score display, timers, issuer panel
Wireframe shows interactions (bug target, leaderboard placeholder, issuers panel)
Brief styling guidance for beginner-friendly implementation

roles.name: Data Scanner
success_checks: Scan plan lists folders and parsing approach
issuers_index.json groups issuer names by period folder for every infotable.xml
Handles missing or malformed XML gracefully

roles.name: Frontend Developer
success_checks: Bug moves randomly, clicks increment score, timer ends game at 20s
Right panel lists periods with issuer names from issuers_index.json
Leaderboard section hooks to backend GET/POST /scores and updates UI

roles.name: Backend Developer
success_checks: Express-like server with in-memory scores, GET /health returns status, GET/POST /scores manage top 10
CORS/static support so frontend can call API locally
Docs explain start instructions and data shapes

roles.name: Tester
success_checks: Test plan outlines manual checks for gameplay, data panel, leaderboard
Shell script hits /health and /scores endpoints to confirm responses
Notes include verifying issuers_index.json load failures

global_constraints: Keep files small, plain JS/CSS/HTML, no frameworks
All paths relative to repo and organized per role folders
Frontend must load issuers_index.json and show issuer names grouped by period
Game lasts exactly 20 seconds before showing final score
